title: Security Control 3D Taxonomy
description: Interactive HTML/SVG grid classifying security controls by function (preventive, detective, corrective, compensating) and type (administrative, technical, physical). Hover a cell for additional examples; reflows to one column on narrow screens.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: cybersecurity

educational.topic: Security control taxonomy: function and type
learningObjectives: Classify a security control by its function (preventive, detective, corrective, compensating).
Classify a security control by its type (administrative, technical, physical).
Give examples that fall in each of the twelve function-by-type combinations.
educational.prerequisites: Awareness that organizations use a mix of policies, technology, and physical measures.

pedagogical.assessment: Discussion questions ask students to place a given control in the correct cell and to design a compensating control.
misconceptionsAddressed: Equating 'security control' with 'technical control' and ignoring administrative and physical controls.
Confusing a compensating control with a corrective control.
